pinev: Parcel-level: the 1874 Bliss county map shows his strip at the W edge of sec 14 T16N R7W (Campbell Twp), from the La Crosse River across the railway; the c.1915 plat shows the sister on the same ground; no house mark (about 300 m).

1903 probate (La Crosse Co case filed 14 Mar 1903; c.1917 corrective petition) describes his farm as about 134 acres in secs 14-15 T16N R7W, including the NW1/4 SW1/4 and Lot 3 of sec 14, down to the La Crosse River, matching the pin.

tw-wi-la-crosse-schaefermeyer-farm-1904.st: His probate shows an estate of $8,800 in land and about $3,300 in notes and mortgages, with no cash found on the premises.
src: La Crosse Co WI probate, case files 3227-3297 (Wisconsin Wills and Probate, Ancestry, PC (b)); research/ancestry/schaefermeyer-la-crosse-probate.md
